research.title: Support Request Classification with Sparse Text Features
bullets: Prepared labeled support requests by removing duplicate messages, normalizing formatting, and checking category consistency against supplied annotation guidelines.
Implemented TF-IDF and logistic regression baselines using predefined data splits, reporting macro-averaged F score and reviewing confusion patterns between related categories.

research.title: Sentence-Level Detection of Speculative Language
bullets: Prepared annotated sentences from scientific abstracts, checking label alignment and preserving document boundaries when constructing training and evaluation partitions.
Implemented word and character n-gram classification baselines, comparing precision and recall and inspecting errors involving negation and ambiguous uncertainty markers.

work.title: Order Processing and Inventory Support
bullets: Checked incoming order forms for missing information, maintained filing records, and routed incomplete requests to the appropriate staff for clarification.
Reconciled delivery paperwork with received supplies, updated inventory logs, and prepared routine handover notes documenting outstanding orders and stock discrepancies.

projects.title: TF-IDF Retrieval for Frequently Asked Questions
bullets: Implemented a baseline question retrieval pipeline using TF-IDF vectors and cosine similarity to rank candidate answers from a supplied collection.
Evaluated ranked results against reference matches and examined retrieval failures caused by vocabulary mismatch, short queries, and overlapping question topics.

projects.title: Naive Bayes Sentiment Classification
bullets: Implemented a multinomial naive Bayes baseline for review sentiment classification, using token counts and a fixed training and test partition.
Compared unigram and bigram feature configurations and inspected misclassified reviews containing mixed sentiment, negated adjectives, and references to multiple product attributes.
